jobs.title: Global Talent Acquisition Partner (all genders)
jobs.description: About us Distribusion is the world’s leading ground transportation marketplace and gives travellers seamless access to ground transportation online, from search to ticket purchase. We have built a cutting-edge B2B technology platform that connects bus, rail, and ferry operators in 70+ countries with the biggest online retailers, including Google Maps and Booking.com . We are shaping the future of travel and building the largest global network of transport providers and retailers. We are one of the fastest-growing startups in travel, backed by leading venture capital investors including TQ Ventures, Lightrock, Creandum, and Northzone, and are headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Following our recent $80m Series C funding, we are ready to push beyond. The opportunity We are seeking a Talent Acquisition Partner : an individual who is passionate about enabling a product-led organisation by engaging and hiring talented members across all different Business areas. What you will do: Own hiring end-to-end, from intake through offer, across the Product & Partnerships areas globally as your primary area of depth, but not limited to it. Build your business acumen around your business areas and be a true Talent Partner to the business. Work as a peer to hiring managers and leadership: run intakes that sharpen unclear requirements, research and advise when a profile isn't feasible, calibrate on candidates, and hold the process to a standard when timelines get tight. Develop sourcing strategies for talent that rarely applies; from passive outreach, Boolean, referrals, networking, and competitive intelligence across travel tech, marketplaces, and B2B SaaS. Maintain pipelines for critical and recurring roles, so we're not starting from zero each time a requisition opens. Coach hiring managers on interviewing and keep our assessment consistent as teams grow. jobs.title: Senior Manager, Human Resources
jobs.description: Job Description We are looking for a commercially minded, hands-on Senior Human Resources Manager to lead all People & Culture functions at our Australian fulfillment center. Serving as the dedicated HR Business Partner to the Site Director, you will own the end-to-end people strategy, workforce capability, and daily HR operations for a large, multi-shift frontline and salaried workforce. Operating within a matrixed People model, you will manage an on-site HR team while partnering closely with our specialised Centres of Excellence (COEs)—including Talent Acquisition, Total Rewards, People Operations, and Work Health & Safety (WHS)—to translate people initiatives into practical, high-impact site execution. You will… Strategic Business Partnering Site Leadership Partnership: Act as a trusted advisor and coach to the Site Director and site department heads on organisational design, leadership effectiveness, change management, and peak-volume workforce scaling. Workforce Planning: Partner with Site Operations, Planning, and Workforce Staffing to forecast seasonal headcount requirements, optimise labour mix (permanent vs. casual/agency), and align staffing plans with production targets. Local Organizational Design & Effectiveness : Act as a thought partner and provide strategic influence to the Site Operations team when it comes to performance management, team structuring, succession planning, and ensuring team members fully understand their job expectations and accountability measures.  Site HR Operations & Team Leadership End-to-End HR Ownership: Oversee the execution and compliance of all Site HR operations, ensuring consistent, high-touch support for frontline associates, team leaders, and site managers both locally and through remote COE’s. Team Development: (where applicable) Lead, mentor, and develop an on-site HR team,  building capability and ensuring clear accountability across the employee lifecycle. Employee & Industrial Relation

jobs.title: Senior Technical Recruiter (Global)
jobs.description: About BJAK The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name. Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia. Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you. The Role We are looking for a Senior Technical Recruiter (Global) to drive hiring across Engineering, Product, Data, AI, Infrastructure, and other technical functions globally. This role combines hands-on recruitment execution with leadership responsibilities. You will be responsible for attracting top technical talent, partnering with senior stakeholders on hiring strategy, and helping build a high-performing Talent Acquisition function as the company continues to scale globally. You will play a critical role in shaping BJAK’s technical workforce while mentoring junior recruiters and establishing best-in-class recruiting practices across the organization. What You’ll Do Technical Recruitment Leadership Own the end-to-end recruitment process for technical positions across Engineering, Product, Data, AI, Machine Learning, Infrastructure, DevOps, Cybersecurity, QA, and related functions. Partner with hiring managers and senior leaders

Our shared commitment to caring for each other and those we serve is what sets us apart. Interesse an Menschen, Kommunikation und Unternehmenskultur. Kreatives Denken und Freude an Text, Social Media & Employer Branding. Eigeninitiative, Teamfähigkeit und Organisationstalent. jobs.description: Du möchtest die Personalarbeit nicht nur verwalten, sondern aktiv mitgestalten? Bei CCI Fördertechnik GmbH verbindest du verlässliche HR-Administration mit Recruiting, Onboarding und Employer Branding. Du hältst die Personalprozesse im Alltag zusammen und entwickelst gemeinsam mit Geschäftsführung, Abteilungsleitungen und Marketing neue Ideen, um CCI Fördertechnik als Arbeitgeber sichtbarer zu machen. Dabei arbeitest du eigenständig und hast kurze Entscheidungswege. Aufgaben Du betreust die Personaladministration – von Mitarbeiterdaten und Verträgen bis zu Arbeitszeiten und lohnrelevanten Unterlagen. Du organisierst den Recruitingprozess, führst Bewerbungsgespräche und koordinierst das Onboarding neuer Mitarbeitender. Gemeinsam mit dem Marketing entwickelst du Recruiting und Arbeitgebermarke weiter, zum Beispiel über passende Stellenkanäle, Jobmessen und HR-Inhalte. Außerdem unterstützt du die interne Kommunikation und Organisationsprojekte. Das bringst du mit Eine abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation. Eine verantwortungsvolle Aufgabe mit viel Eigenständigkeit, kurzen Entscheidungswegen und direkter Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsführung. Ein familiäres, kollegiales Arbeitsumfeld.
